def owner.zero
  (bytes : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (index : Std.U8) : Result Bool := do
  if index >= 32#u8
  then ok true
  else
    let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize index)
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize bytes i
    if i1 != 0#u8
    then ok false
    else let i2 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add index 1#u8)
         owner.zero bytes i2
